BranchState.description: One dispatched unit of a fan-out (specs §18).

subtask.description: decomposition only: the part of the work this branch owns.
subtask.title: Subtask

owned_criteria.description: decomposition only: ids of the run's TaskCriterion this branch is accountable for. Every locked criterion MUST be owned by exactly one branch or retained at the join (specs §18).
owned_criteria.title: Owned Criteria

BranchState.title: BranchState

BudgetReservation.description:
Resources promised to work which has not completed yet.

Reservations make concurrent branch dispatch safe: an admission decision counts both
recorded spend and work already admitted elsewhere.
BudgetReservation.title: BudgetReservation

Constraint.description: Hard limits that must not be violated.
Constraint.title: Constraint

CriterionResult.description: One scored criterion, for a run's result vector or a certification observation.

context_hash.description: Hash of the exact context a judge saw; makes an isolation violation provable.
context_hash.title: Context Hash

CriterionResult.title: CriterionResult

FailureSignal.description:
Raised by the orchestrator, solver, validator, or join — never inferred after the fact.

``classify_failure``'s only precondition is that a ``FailureSignal`` exists on the run
state (ADR-0008); this replaces the old, unsatisfiable-for-most-classes precondition of
"some required criterion failed."

``class_hint`` is an optional structured producer signal (e.g. budget preflight via
``budget_excess``). When set, ``classify_failure`` prefers it over detail substring matching.
FailureSignal.title: FailureSignal

Goal.description: Primary task input. Compiles to TaskCriterion[] at intake.

context.description: Optional natural-language context / human label. Never the sole success contract.
context.title: Context

preferences.description: Soft guidance (style, verbosity, preferred tools). Advisory only.
preferences.title: Preferences

mea_opt_in.description: Per-Goal MEA layer of three-layer activation (policy.mea_enabled + this flag + Task.execution_strategy). Default false.
mea_opt_in.title: Mea Opt In

Goal.title: Goal

MergeAudit.description: Every fan-in records expected against received inputs (specs §26.4).

batches.description: Actual fan-in batches in execution order; empty for a direct merge.
batches.title: Batches

MergeAudit.title: MergeAudit

ResourceClaim.description:
A declared claim on something shared outside the workspace.

Two units conflict when they claim the same ``id`` and at least one ``mode`` is ``write``
or ``exclusive`` — whether or not an ``input_bindings``-derived dependency exists between them.
ResourceClaim.title: ResourceClaim

ResourceConflict.description: One recorded wait on a claimed resource (specs §26.2).
ResourceConflict.title: ResourceConflict

RunManifest.description: Full system fingerprint; any measurement ties to an exact state (specs §11.3).

criteria_hash.description: sha256 of the locked TaskCriterion set's canonical serialisation.
criteria_hash.title: Criteria Hash

RunManifest.title: RunManifest

RunState.description: State threaded through every node (specs §3). Nodes return deltas, never a mutated copy.

criteria.description: Required set; immutable after intake. Never populated from a chosen skill.
criteria.title: Criteria

suppressed_skill.description: Skill withheld for a randomized per-skill suppression comparison.

certification_observations.description: Advisory: the applied skill's certification criteria scored against this run's artifact. Feeds SkillStats/needs_recert only; never gates routing or the caller's result (ADR-0003 amendment).
certification_observations.title: Certification Observations

mea_active.description: True when three-layer MEA activation succeeded at intake.
mea_active.title: Mea Active

mea_fallback_reason.description: Set when MEA was requested but any activation layer was missing.
mea_fallback_reason.title: Mea Fallback Reason

RunState.title: RunState

SensitivityProof.description: Evidence that a criterion rejects a known-bad artifact (specs §15.2).

evidence_hash.description: sha256 hash binding the criterion definition to the negative-fixture fingerprint used for this proof
evidence_hash.title: Evidence Hash

SensitivityProof.title: SensitivityProof

goal.description: Preferred primary input (Variant B). Compiles to TaskCriterion[] at intake.

request.description: Optional natural-language context / legacy entry point. Never the sole success contract when a Goal is present.
request.title: Request

is_eval_fixture.description: When true, distill must not author library memory (M3 firewall ahead of M4's full eval firewall). Golden / promotion runs set this so the regression gate cannot recursively learn from itself.
is_eval_fixture.title: Is Eval Fixture

execution_strategy.description: Runtime MEA layer. 'mea' takes effect only with policy.mea_enabled and Goal.mea_opt_in. Default 'single' is the zero-cost ordinary path.
execution_strategy.title: Execution Strategy

TaskCriterion.description: Locked at ``intake`` for one run. Never authored by a chosen skill.
TaskCriterion.title: TaskCriterion

description: Persisted checkpoint envelope around a ``RunState`` snapshot (specs §5.3).
title: CheckpointRecord
